 Peter June Simon suffers medical emergency during basketball game
 November 20, 2026 
 FASTBREAK.COM.PH 
 Share this FASTBREAK story:
 Former PBA standout Peter June Simon suffered a medical emergency while playing in a basketball game on Friday night, prompting fellow players and former teammates to seek prayers for his recovery.
 Videos circulating on social media showed the former Magnolia Chicken Timplados Hotshots player receiving medical attention from several teammates after he reportedly collapsed during a Panalay basketball game in Davao 
 The circumstances surrounding the incident and Simon’s current medical condition have yet to be confirmed.
 Several current and former PBA players took to social media to express concern and call on the basketball community to pray for the veteran guard’s recovery.
 Simon, widely known as one of the most reliable scorers of his generation, built an accomplished career in the PBA, particularly with the Purefoods franchise, which later became the Star Hotshots and Magnolia.
 Nicknamed the “Scoring Apostle,” Simon was a key contributor to the franchise’s championship runs and became one of its most recognizable players.
 He earned the 2009 PBA Most Improved Player award and was named Finals Most Valuable Player during the 2014 Governors’ Cup, further cementing his reputation as one of the league’s dependable big-game performers.
 His condition following Friday night’s incident has yet to be officially disclosed. (Adrian Co)
